meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会先组建一个 5 人对抗团队,成员之间互相攻击批判,只保留经得起攻击的洞见,再交给一个专门的 planner 任务把它们正式写成方案。
howto.when: 当你要求方案规划达到最高强度,或提到 hyperplan、对抗式(交叉批评)方案时触发;前提是 lead 团队工具可用且你在顶层 lead 会话。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次重构
say.note: 先启动 5 人敌对团队互评,再交 planner 成文

say.text: 对这份发布方案做交叉批评,只留能站住的结论
say.note: 成员互相攻击后由你蒸馏幸存洞见

say.text: 把这次迁移计划按 hyperplan 流程走一遍
say.note: 对抗评审多轮后交专门 planner 正式化

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Lead of a 5-member adversarial team whose members cross-critique each other; only insights that survive the attacks are kept, then handed to a dedicated planner to formalize.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or you ask for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan. Requires the lead team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this refactor.
say_en.note: Spawns 5 hostile members, then a planner formalizes.

say_en.text: Cross-critique this release plan; keep only defensible findings.
say_en.note: Members attack; the lead distills survivors.

say_en.text: Run this migration plan through the hyperplan flow.
